projects.title: The Wilds Beyond
projects.description: An adventure guide for D&D campaigns. Follow hidden roads, explore strange horizons, and discover stories beyond the lantern light.

projects.title: City of Embers
projects.description: A D&D campaign setting of rooftops and old magic. Explore a city that refuses to go quietly into the dark.

projects.title: The Lantern Moth
projects.description: A creature compendium for your D&D campaign. Discover strange monsters and encounter ideas that make every road feel alive.

projects.title: Ash & Oath
projects.description: A short D&D campaign of old promises and dangerous ruins. Give your players choices that shape the story and leave a mark.

projects.title: The Glass Isles
projects.description: A nautical hexcrawl for D&D, with island maps and impossible tides. Chart a course through a sea that remembers everyone who crosses it.

projects.title: Mercenary Organizations
projects.description: A faction guide for Dungeon Masters. Build rival mercenary companies and put the cost of victory at the heart of your D&D campaign.

projects.title: The Entertainers
projects.description: Performer NPCs and entertainment traditions for D&D. Bring memorable characters and new stories to the stages and taverns of your world.

projects.title: Villain Story Engine
projects.description: A Dungeon Master toolkit for memorable D&D villains. Use their secrets, plans, and lairs to drive your campaign forward.
